caption: The drawing shows two objects, a fork and a knife, each placed vertically side by side against a plain beige background. The fork is on the left, with four metal tines and a long, straight handle resembling light-colored wood with subtle brown grain patterns. The knife is on the right, with a broad, rounded metal blade and a handle matching the fork's in both color and pattern. Both handles are rectangular and slightly tapered. The metallic parts of the utensils are rendered in gray tones with some shading for dimensional effect. The composition is centered, and the objects are presented in an upright orientation, occupying the middle of the image. There is a small signature in the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Knife and Fork
